general principal, we try our best to be 'squeaky clean' in our operations. When we are looking at taking on an
investor, we run background checks to make sure we don't sign contracts with anyone who has a history that
could cause us trouble. The same with our PR people and the talent for the shows we are working on.

I put this down in writing so I could say things plainly and clearly, but I usually like to talk things like this over
